title: Ukraine Strikes Rare Russian S-400 Launchers Covertly Moved from Kapustin Yar Test Range
detail: Ukraine located and struck rare Russian S-400 air defense launchers that had been covertly moved from the Kapustin Yar strategic test range, a significant combined intelligence and precision strike success. The S-400 systems had been transferred from the storied Russian ballistic missile and space test site in Astrakhan Oblast, making their targeting a notable intelligence achievement.
